description: Resolve an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer against a JSON document, in both the plain form ("" for the whole document, or "/foo/0") and the URI-fragment form ("#/foo/0"). Handles ~1 -> / and ~0 -> ~ escaping, and distinguishes an invalid document / malformed pointer from a syntactically valid pointer whose target is simply absent.

json.description: The JSON document to resolve against

name: resolve_json_pointer
